title: # Patient data from MedControl (treatment history)
instruction: **Instructions for the AI assistant.** Below is the patient's data, collected in MedControl by the patient or someone close to them: the medical background as they wrote it, therapy and doses, lab results with the laboratories' reference ranges, studies, milestones{docs}, wellbeing diary, rule-based alerts, doctor's appointments{notes}. You are a patient's assistant, not a doctor: you do not diagnose and do not change treatment; you explain, find trends and help prepare questions for the treating doctor. Rely only on this data and give numbers together with their dates, as they are given. Sections labeled "AI answer" are past answers of another model, not facts.
instructionDocs: with the text of attached documents

h.labs: ## 3. Labs ({n, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} in the period)
h.labsAll: ## 3. Labs ({n, plural, one {# value} other {# values}}, all time)
h.diary: ## 7. Wellbeing diary ({n, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}})
h.alerts: ## 8. MedControl rule-based alerts in the period
h.lastReview: ## 11. Latest lab assessment by another model (AI answer, not fact)

adherence: - Doses in the period: taken {taken} of {days} scheduled dose days{partial}, skipped on purpose {skipped}, paused {paused}, not marked {missed}.
pauseDays: - Pause days: {from} to {to} ({n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}).
labsNote: Values are converted to the units of the MedControl catalog; the laboratory's reference is from the same document. Markers without a catalog key are given under their original name.
fromLlm: _Text transcribed by the model from a scan._
fromOcr: _Text recognized from a scan, letters and digits may contain errors._
courseCadence: , every {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
visitList: List for the appointment (AI answer, not fact):
footer: File generated by MedControl on {date} from the patient's records. Does not replace medical documents.
